title: Figma Design, Straight to Your Coding Agent
content:
[TITLE: Figma Design, Straight to Your Coding Agent]

[HOOK: split screen - Figma design | code editor]
What the designer built...
aur jo developer ne banaya...
ab DONO same honge.

[SCREEN: Figma blog - Introducing Specs | Oct 15, 2026 | Source: figma.com/blog]
Figma just launched SPECS.
Abhi ye open beta mein hai...
and it's only on paid plans.

[CAM: medium]
So what exactly is Specs?
Simple words mein... ek Markdown document.
It lives RIGHT next to your design.
Requirements, decisions, diagrams... sab ek hi jagah.
Ab "ye button aisa kyun hai?" wala sawaal...
Slack mein dhoondhna nahi padega.
The answer sits right there with the design.

[SCREEN: Cursor / Claude Code with Figma MCP connected]
But here's the real magic.
Figma ka MCP server.
Iske through aapka coding agent...
spec ko directly READ kar sakta hai.
Plus the linked designs.
Matlab agent ko pata hai kya banana hai...
and WHY it's building it.

[GRAPHIC: 1. Add mcp.figma.com/mcp  2. Copy spec link  3. Paste in prompt | Source: developers.figma.com]
Use kaise karein? Just three steps.
Step one: apne editor mein remote Figma MCP add karo.
Step two: copy the spec LINK.
Step three: wo link apne agent ke prompt mein daal do.
That's it.

[CAM: close-up]
Ab builder ka angle samjho.
When does an agent write bad code?
Jab model weak ho? Nahi...
mostly, jab CONTEXT kam hota hai.
Agent ko pata hi nahi hota ki designer kya soch raha tha.
So it guesses.
Aur guess ka result... aapko pata hai.
Specs gives it that missing context.
Design, requirements, decisions... sab agent ke saamne.

[CAM: face]
This is a big shift for designers too.
Aapka kaam ab sirf ek screenshot nahi...
it's an INPUT that goes straight into code.

[CAM: face]
I haven't tried it yet.
Main ise apne NEXT project pe try karunga...
and I'll show you whatever happens.

[CTA]
FOLLOW karo...
daily AI, explained by a builder.
